:::{#thm-wcgs-interaction}

#### Interpretation of the interaction coefficient in the WCGS interaction model

In the model of @eq-wcgs-model-1,
write $\odds(p, a) \eqdef \oddst(Y=1|P=p, A=a)$
and
$\ror(\Delta a = 1 | P = p) \eqdef \odds(p, a + 1) / \odds(p, a)$.
Then for every age $a$,
the interaction coefficient $\beta_{PA}$ is the difference between
the slopes of the log-odds of CHD over age
for type A ($P = 1$) and type B ($P = 0$) participants:

$$\beta_{PA} = \deriv{a}\eta(P=1, A = a) - \deriv{a}\eta(P=0, A = a)$$

and $\expf{\beta_{PA}}$ is the ratio of the odds ratios per one-year difference in age:

$$
\expf{\beta_{PA}} =
\frac
{\ror(\Delta a = 1 | P = 1)}
{\ror(\Delta a = 1 | P = 0)}
$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-logistic-coef-interp, worked in @sol-logistic-coef-interp.

:::
